reviews.title: Pretty good!
reviews.comment: Works well, good quality panel (no motion blur for web browsing or videos. I didn't try video games). It's big. The frame is a little wider than the panel itself. Theres a decent size border around the panel too... I could not get the sound over HDMI to work but this could be related to my Pi OS setup (bookworm). There's a bit of sparking when plugging it in but doesn't seem to affect anything. It was easy to set up. It's difficult to manage the cables and route them so it looks clean so expect some cable mess when done.
reviews.author: Arnaud

reviews.title: Mini
reviews.comment: Very good design and built quality. Works perfectly fine with my Samsung Galaxy S24 ultra. Love the compact size which is very convenient when traveling as well as using Samsung Dex. Love it!
reviews.author: canhD_Chula Vista CA

reviews.title: Great bare bones monitor to add to custom builds
reviews.comment: I bought this screen to add in on a portable video mixing build. It’s a great, low cost addition to my setup. The screen size is JUST big enough to see what I need to see but not so small that it’s difficult to see. Picture quality and color are true to need.
reviews.author: Charles Edward Cheese

reviews.title: Touchscreen didn't work
reviews.comment: The monitor displayed the signal fine, but the touchscreen didn't work. The manual said nothing was needed to enable touch functionality, that it would work right out of the box for Windows 11 devices so I assume the unit was defective. Returned it to amazon.
reviews.author: Jacob V

reviews.title: TS for Linux OS
reviews.comment: Touchscreen option doesn't work with raspberry pi or other Linux OS hardware. Otherwise nice little screen.
